Bench: Pankaj Mithal, Yogendra Kumar Srivastava
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 29
Case :- Writ - C No. - 38646 of 2019
Petitioner :- Sonu
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 06 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Meena Mishra

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pankaj Mithal,J.
Hon'ble Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.
Learned Standing Counsel has appeared for the State respondents.

The petitioner wants quashing of the order dated 21.09.2019 passed by the Designated Officer (Food Safety) Kanpur Nagar and at the same time seeks a direction that he may be permitted to resume his small food business in the form of temporary stall for selling chicken meat.

A bare perusal of the impugned order reveals that the petitioner's business has been stopped as he is not having registration/licence to sell the meat as is required under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
In the absence of any such certificate we do not find that there is any error or illegality in the order dated 21.09.2019 passed by the Designated Officer.
